hypothesis: A bounded Gemini-planned second retrieval attempt will improve canonical evidence coverage for difficult and comparative validation questions while preserving the frozen baseline's zero unanswerable false-positive rate.

variants.description: Frozen metadata-aware dense retrieval with one original query.
The same first retrieval followed by deterministic evidence assessment and at most one Gemini-planned rewrite attempt.

singleChangedVariable: Single-pass retrieval versus the complete bounded assessment-and-rewrite policy.

agenticPolicy.assessor: deterministic minimum-score and requested-language coverage gate
agenticPolicy.merge: deduplicate by chunk id, retain highest cosine score, then stable score ordering
agenticPolicy.invalidPlannerOutputPolicy: fail the experiment attempt without coercion

selectionRule.decision: Select the agentic variant only if every threshold and guardrail passes; otherwise retain the single-pass baseline without tuning on observed failures.

preregistrationAmendments.reason: The intended non-inferiority guardrail is the exact frozen baseline value (26/27). The rounded value 0.963 was microscopically stricter and would incorrectly reject an identical result.

limitations: The validation and focused comparative sets have already informed earlier retrieval experiments.
Language coverage is a proxy for evidence sufficiency rather than semantic entailment.
This experiment evaluates retrieval behavior, not final generated-answer quality.
Gemini planner list-price cost is estimated from provider token metadata.
